resources.string: Turn OFF Streak when using Assistant. Say \"complete [habit]\" or \"status\"

Samsung Side key:
Settings → Advanced features → Side key → Double press → Open app → WhisperFlow Voice Keyboard

Samsung Routines / shortcuts:
Action: com.pimax.whisperflow.ACTION_VOICE_KEYBOARD
Or long-press WhisperFlow icon → Voice Keyboard

ADB test:
am start -a com.pimax.whisperflow.ACTION_VOICE_KEYBOARD -n com.pimax.whisperflow/.VoiceKeyboardTriggerActivity

Fallback: double-tap Volume Down. Long-press power still creates tasks.
